definitions.gloss: vehicle dispatch; car allocation; sending a vehicle
definitions.explanation: The act of dispatching or allocating vehicles, especially taxis, delivery trucks, or company cars. Common in transportation, logistics, and ride-hailing contexts.

examples.japanese: タクシーの{配車|はいしゃ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
アプリで{簡単|かんたん}に{配車|はいしゃ}できるようになった。
examples.english: It has become easy to dispatch a car using an app.

examples.japanese: {配車|はいしゃ}センターに{連絡|れんらく}して、{明日|あした}の{朝|あさ}{迎|むか}えの{車|くるま}を{手配|てはい}した。
examples.english: I contacted the dispatch center and arranged a pickup car for tomorrow morning.

notes:
A する verb commonly used in transportation and logistics. With the rise of ride-hailing apps, {配車|はいしゃ}アプリ (ride-hailing app) has become a frequently used compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配車|はいしゃ}サービス (dispatch/ride-hailing service)
- {配車|はいしゃ}アプリ (ride-hailing app)
- {配車|はいしゃ}センター (dispatch center)
- {配車|はいしゃ}{係|がかり} (dispatcher)

Do not confuse with the homophone {歯医者|はいしゃ} (dentist) or {敗者|はいしゃ} (loser/defeated person).
